name: After § 76
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 76d. Condemns any attempts to steal, seize, hoard or otherwise appropriate Venezuelan oil resources and related assets, including through coercive economic measures and extraterritorial enforcement; warns against the extension of such predatory practices to other territories and peoples, in particular Greenland, where hydrocarbons and rare earth elements risk becoming targets of geopolitical resource grabs by the United States;
